versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of dataify-google-finance skill.

- Supports user requests for financial data via Google Finance, including stocks, indices, funds, currencies, and futures.
- Implements a mandatory confirmation workflow: parses user input, builds an explicit Markdown parameter table, and requests explicit confirmation before API calls.
- Applies only documented parameter defaults; prompts for any missing required input.
- Requires sign-in at [Dataify Dashboard](https://dataify.com/dashboard) if API token is missing.
- Returns API responses as-is, following Dataify Scraper API conventions.
